criteria.evidence: The supplied diff adds blank fields to both config files and the ticket template. Tests exercise cmdNew copying config values and reviewerSettings applying overrides and fallback.
runCodexReview conditionally adds model and effort arguments. Tests inspect captured Codex arguments when settings are blank and scan code, templates and skills for model names.

The Codex test exercises argument construction for initial and resumed rounds. The claude-subagent test only searches skill text for parameter names and runs reviewer-settings; it never starts a reviewer or verifies that the Agent tool accepts and applies those parameters.
lintTicket validates ticket and config efforts against EFFORTS. Tests cover every allowed value, several invalid values and an unrestricted model name.

cmdRecord records settings resolved from the current ticket/config, while the skill explicitly retains the original claude-subagent across rounds. If settings change between rounds, metadata reports new settings although the reviewer still uses its original settings. Existing tests cover only unchanged settings.

findings.issue: The claude-subagent AC3 test does not exercise reviewer creation. Matching the words `model` and `effort` in documentation cannot establish that configured settings reach a running reviewer.
findings.suggested_fix: Verify the actual supported Agent tool invocation and add coverage that exercises the invocation with configured and blank settings, including evidence that the chosen parameters are applied.

findings.issue: cmdRecord derives metadata from current configuration rather than the settings used to start the retained claude-subagent. Editing model or effort between rounds therefore creates an inaccurate review history and pack.
findings.suggested_fix: Persist the settings used when starting the subagent and reuse them when recording resumed rounds, or restart the reviewer when settings change. Add a regression test that changes settings between rounds.

product_md.note: The claim that every saved round records the settings used is inaccurate for a retained claude-subagent after configuration changes. Configured subagent execution also lacks behavioural verification.

verdict.summary: The Codex settings path has useful tests, but the Claude reviewer path is not demonstrated and can report settings different from those actually used. Fix those gaps before merge. Repository reads and independent test execution were blocked by the sandbox failing to start; this review relies on the supplied diff and test output.
